summary: Open a file in a local interactive editor, attached to the current terminal.

path.description: File to open in the editor.

editor.description: Editor to launch. auto uses VISUAL/EDITOR first, then a platform default.

wait.description: For editors that support it, wait until the file is closed before returning.

node.semanticNotes: Requires an interactive terminal. Web/server/CI contexts return a safe error instead of launching an editor. Dry-run previews the selected editor command.
